Part 1 高频 物品 OBJECTS

Gifts

礼物

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Have you ever sent handmade gifts to others?

Yes, I have, actually. I once made a handmade card for a friend's birthday and wrote a message inside, which she really appreciated. I think handmade things feel more personal than bought ones.

送过，曾给朋友手工做生日贺卡并写上留言，手作礼物更有心意。

Q2Have you ever received a great gift?

Well, I've received nice gifts, but nothing that truly surprised me. Most gifts I get are practical things, like clothes or gadgets. Honestly, I don't think I've had that wow moment yet.

收过不错的礼物，但没遇过特别惊喜的，大多是衣服、小电器这类实用品。

Q3What do you consider when choosing a gift?

The recipient's preferences, definitely. I always try to think about what the person actually likes instead of just picking something expensive. After all, a gift only works if the other person enjoys it.

最看重对方喜好，会想对方真正喜欢什么，而不是只挑贵的。

Q4Do you think you are good at choosing gifts?

I'd say I'm fairly decent at it. Because I pay attention to what people like, my choices usually hit the mark. That said, I still get it wrong from time to time, honestly.

还算擅长，因为平时留意对方喜好，选的礼物大多合适，偶尔也会失手。

Q5What gift have you received recently?

An electric shaver, actually. My family gave it to me not long ago, which was quite thoughtful since I'd mentioned needing one. It's simple, but I use it almost every day.

最近收到家人送的电动剃须刀，因为我提过需要，很贴心，几乎天天用。
